g.text: Synchronous counters share a clock; ripple counters cascade clock events

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Up-counter sequence000…111 repeats; state labels are Q2 Q1 Q0. Synchronous toggles require T0=1,T1=Q0,T2=Q0Q1. In ripple form, falling Q of one stage
clocks the next. Idealized per-stage delay0.06 event units illustrates transient invalid ripple states; it is not a device specification.
